issues.description: Milkable.messageOnMilk signature and required output are inconsistent between the problem statement/UML and the provided solution. The problem statement/UML specifies a no-argument method `messageOnMilk(): String` returning exactly "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". However, the solution defines `String messageOnMilk(double volume)` in Milkable and implements it in Goat/Seal with volume-specific text (e.g., "... is milked (xL)"). A student implementing the no-arg method as specified would not match the reference implementation (and any tests based on it), and the provided Main snippet also calls `messageOnMilk()` with no arguments.
issues.suggestedFix: Align all artifacts to the spec: change Milkable to `String messageOnMilk();` and update Goat/Seal to implement `messageOnMilk()` returning exactly "Goat <name> is milked" / "Seal <name> is milked" (no volume). Alternatively, if volume is intended, update the UML/problem statement text and both Main snippets to require `messageOnMilk(double volume)` and specify the exact output format including volume.
